title: Hiring Right Now
lede: Hiring Right Now, from the Backdoor team, reads a public LinkedIn profile and returns growing startups that fit the work you have done, the founder to contact and a drafted first email.

points: You paste a public LinkedIn URL; the tool searches growing startups and shows your ten best fits.
Each match names the founder to write to, and the top match comes with a drafted email.
The team says the draft ties something you have built to what that startup is working on.
The paid Backdoor service keeps finding matches and runs follow-ups; you approve each first email, and approved mail goes out from your own Gmail.

sections.text: Job seekers who want to approach startup founders directly instead of applying through job boards and waiting.
Matches and the first draft are free, with no signup or card. The ongoing Backdoor outreach is paid, with 50% off a 90-day plan during launch week.
